input.reply:
Thanks for the detailed report and StackBlitz reproductions. This is clearly a regression—test B should not see properties added to window.navigator in test A, as was correctly happening in 4.0.2.

The behavior change between 4.0.2 and 4.0.6 suggests a modification to how globals are reset or isolated between test runs. Since you've narrowed it to this range, can you test 4.0.3 to confirm the breakage started there? Knowing which specific version broke it helps identify the culprit commit.
